323010.title: Linear singular-index conjecture for unsatisfiable hitting clause-sets
323010.analysis: Fixed deficiency does not bound the number of variables introduced by inverse singular DP steps. Need a uniform lower density of initially singular variables in a maximal singular elimination sequence. No full combinatorial charging argument; source definitions beyond literal record unread.

323537.title: Murty–Simon conjecture on diameter-two edge-critical graphs
323537.analysis: Diameter-two criticality assigns a witness pair to each deleted edge, but several edges can share a pair. An injective charging to cross-part pairs or a sharp global overlap bound is unpaid, as is extremal uniqueness. No purported resolution of this flagship.

323999.title: The weak virtual periodicity conjecture for maximal coclass trees
323999.analysis: Finite coclass layers do not imply repetition of infinite rooted subtrees, especially over arbitrary fields. Need finite-state transition control uniform in depth; no such theorem or construction authenticated.

324375.title: The algebraic-extension characterization via Stallings graph coverings
324375.analysis: Record is internally contradictory about public refutation and defines algebraic extension relative to ambient F rather than absence of a proper free factor of J containing H. A counterexample to one interpretation cannot resolve the other. Exact source and all-basis covering witness unread; no exclusion adopted.

324805.title: The Newton polygon conjecture for tree coefficients
324805.analysis: Tree coefficient sympawn is not defined in the literal record. Need source recurrence, numerator normalization, and all boundary-face valuations with no cancellation. Height-shift conventions also unpaid; a guessed q-hook formula is insufficient.

325072.title: The one-third–two-thirds conjecture for antimatroids
325072.analysis: Contains the finite poset 1/3–2/3 problem as a special case. An adjacent basic-word swap only gives local pairing, not a global 1/3 bound. No uniform injection or extremal reduction survives; source body unread.

325100.title: The complete-partite graph cycle-space conjecture for K^{s,s-1}
325100.analysis: Full all-s rectangle-switch proof in ordinary-derivations.md matches source Definition 3 and Conjecture 5. Source current PDF v3 retains it. Prior, journal/corrections, significance and independent review unpaid; not a routine exclusion and no dispatch.

325429.title: The higher-dimensional bootstrapping conjecture for lattice walks
325429.analysis: Shuffle insertion of an inward step is plausible only after proving every inserted prefix remains in the rational region. For two steps, absence of drift must be defined: vector sum, weighted mean and each boundary condition differ. Need admissible inserted-word family of exponential rate 2 and an injective encoding with a common start. No exact source-semantic bridge; no correction exclusion.

325449.title: The regular-word existence and uniqueness conjecture for generalized Thue–Morse sequences
325449.analysis: Moment cancellation gives an integer polynomial divisible by (x−1)^(r+1), but does not itself force length divisible by 2^r or uniqueness at length 2^(r+1). Need exact definition, equivalence under complement/reversal, and bounded-coefficient factor control for all r. No program or witness search.

325572.title: Cui–Hou switching-equivalence conjecture for skew spectra of bipartite graphs
325572.analysis: Exact source Theorem 2.2 resolves both directions; full induction/switching bridge in ordinary-derivations.md. Credit zero.

325706.title: Signless Laplacian power-sum conjecture for bipartite graphs
325706.analysis: Source Conjecture 3.1 is literally refuted by Ashraf 2014 Theorem 7. Manual K(2,4), alpha=5 witness gives 8896>8748 and complete source-spectrum bridge. Credit zero.

327560.title: Characterization of Kyle graphs among symmetric directed graphs
327560.analysis: If symmetric means bidirected then rows and columns conflict at floor(m/2), but this cannot be used without authenticating the source meaning of symmetric and Ratanang parameters. Kyle graph definitions and body unread. No typo-derived solution or exclusion.

328297.title: The Taylor-to-SD(wedge) conjecture for oriented trees
328297.analysis: A Taylor term is not generally enough for meet-semidistributivity; must use oriented-tree structure to exclude affine/type obstructions. Special-tree source result does not pay arbitrary branching. No general polymorphism construction or concrete counterexample.

329350.title: Generalized M-polynomial product conjecture for graded Lie algebra components
329350.analysis: Requires grading-specific classification and poset generating functions; products in abelian/extra-special cases do not cover all gradings. Height compatibility and finite-type case completeness unpaid. No source theorem-body comparison; no classification computed.

336647.title: The classification conjecture for groups admitting oriented regular representations
336647.analysis: Requires all finite solvable groups beyond the source non-solvable/three-generator cases. Random Cayley constructions need control of non-regular automorphisms, not merely generators. Exact eleven exceptions and current classification body unverified; no claim current conjecture remains open.

349858.title: The even-stretch lower-bound conjecture for fault-tolerant spanners
349858.analysis: An all-f lower bound without a relation between f and n is not meaningful uniformly since simple graphs have at most n(n−1)/2 edges. This is a domain issue, not a substantive refutation. Need actual allowed f range and girth/blow-up construction retaining even-k exponent; neither supplied by literal record.

351285.title: The local-distance conjecture for autoencoder generalization
351285.analysis: Actual source Conjecture 3.1 is qualitative; no comparison quantifiers, fixed test distribution, projection metric or training protocol fixes the claimed monotonicity. Locally identical smooth maps can differ away from training points, but that observation is not a literal trained-network theorem/refutation. Definition 2.4 and local discussion read, no significant endpoint claimed.

351481.title: Conjectural formulas for cluster variables of star graphs
351481.analysis: Actual Conjecture 5.1 uses the same non-rooted star cluster and has an unbound i inside a j-sum. Repairing that index alone does not prove the formulas; rooted-cluster expansions do not extend automatically (source explicitly identifies missing hyper-T-path rules). Need exact intended expression and LP exchange/denominator induction. No exclusion just for typo.

355434.title: The inverse conjugation conjecture for bidding games
355434.analysis: Actual Conjecture 69 concerns every invertible bidding game. Uniqueness of inverses only proves H equals the conjugate once G+conjugate(G)=0 is established. Mirror play spends shared budget and can fail, unlike alternating play. Source zero-bid proviso cannot be dropped; no proof invertibility supplies it or all-context transport. Number-only Theorem 26 is insufficient.

381816.title: The recurrence equivalent to the conjectural formula for rho sub 2,3
381816.analysis: The recurrence is not specified independently of preceding rho definition and admissible s,n. A binomial recurrence verifies a proposed formula conditionally; it does not show the stationary TASEP correlation satisfies it. Need exact probability/integral-to-count bridge and transition bijection preserving the model. Source body unread.
